Foundation in Computing & Engineering

Strong foundations.
Create Exceptional
Technology Professionals.

One year. The right foundation. A direct path to a degree in computing, engineering, software, cybersecurity, AI, or data science. The Foundation in Computing & Engineering is designed for students who are ready to commit to a future in technology and want to start building it the right way — with strong academics, real technical exposure, and a direct progression route into UNIMY’s full range of undergraduate programmes.

Your tech career starts here.

1

Future Careers

The first step toward limitless possibilities.

This foundation is your entry point into one of the most in-demand career landscapes in the world. Technology is one of the highest-paying and fastest-growing fields for graduates in Malaysia. The MyDIGITAL blueprint targeted 500,000 digital economy jobs by 2025. Demand for AI and data talent is growing at 103% year-on-year according to PwC’s 2025 Global AI Jobs Barometer. The National Semiconductor Strategy is targeting 60,000 skilled engineers by 2030. Every one of these opportunities starts with the right foundation.

Completing this programme opens direct progression into UNIMY’s full range of undergraduate degrees in computing and engineering — and from there into careers across software development, cybersecurity, AI, data science, robotics, and more.

Why This Programme Matters

The Reality

  • Malaysia’s technology sector is growing faster than the local talent pipeline can fill — creating a structural shortage of skilled graduates across software, cybersecurity, AI, and engineering
  • 59% of technology employers in Malaysia are actively expanding their headcount, and the competition for qualified graduates is intensifying every year
  • A strong foundation in mathematics, computing, and engineering thinking is the single most important determinant of success in any technology degree — and most students who struggle at degree level do so because their foundation was weak
  • Starting with the right pre-university programme is not just about meeting entry requirements — it is about arriving at your degree confident, capable, and ready to perform from day one

The Education

This is not a generic pre-university programme with computing modules added on. Every subject in the Foundation in Computing & Engineering is chosen because it directly prepares you for the demands of a technology or engineering degree. Mathematics, physics, programming, digital technology, and critical thinking are taught by experienced technology professionals, not just academics — giving you a first-year experience that already feels like working in the industry.

No prior coding experience is required. This programme is designed for students starting from scratch, and by the end of it you will have working knowledge of programming, digital systems, electric circuits, calculus, and statistics — the complete foundation for any computing or engineering degree.

3

The AI-Native Learning Experience

UNIMY is Malaysia's AI-native university. That identity starts here, from the very first semester of the Foundation programme. Students are introduced to digital technology, computing fundamentals, and programming in an environment where AI tools are part of how learning happens - not a topic saved for later years.

  • Industry-Grade Labs from Day One

    Train in computer labs and smart classrooms equipped with the latest software, simulation environments, and cybersecurity tools. You learn like a tech professional from your first week.

  • Taught by Real Tech Professionals

    Lecturers are experienced practitioners from computing, AI, electronics, and engineering industries. They bring real-world problems into the classroom and give you the professional context that textbooks cannot.

  • Coursera for Campus Access

    Foundation students have access to Coursera for Campus, enabling them to begin earning microcredentials from Google, IBM, AWS, and Microsoft alongside their foundation studies — building an industry-recognised profile before they even start their degree.

  • Project & Lab-Based Learning

    A mix of lectures, hands-on labs, group projects, and industry-related assignments ensures that learning is active and applied from the start, not passive.

5

Career Outcomes

The Foundation in Computing & Engineering is not a destination. It is the launchpad.

The career outcomes for this programme are defined by where it takes you - and it takes you directly into the degree programmes that lead to the highest-growth, best-compensated careers in Malaysia's technology sector.

Students who complete this foundation and progress into a UNIMY undergraduate degree go on to careers in software engineering, cybersecurity, data science, AI, computer engineering, robotics, and digital media.

The Malaysian technology sector is expanding faster than local universities can produce graduates, and UNIMY’s Foundation students enter that pipeline from the very first year of their education.

PROGRESSION PATHWAYS

Upon completing the Foundation in Computing & Engineering, students can progress directly into the following UNIMY undergraduate programmes, with credit given for the foundation year:

  • Bachelor of Computer Science (Hons)
  • Bachelor of Computer Science (Data Science) with Honours
  • Bachelor of Software Engineering (Hons)
  • Bachelor of Computer Engineering (Hons)
  • Bachelor of Information Technology (Cyber Security) with Honours
  • Bachelor of Game Development (Game Technology) with Honours
  • Bachelor of Multimedia (Interactive Media) with Honours

7

Entry Requirements

To be eligible for the Foundation in Computing & Engineering, applicants must meet one of the following:

  • Pass SPM / SPMV — credit in any 5 subjects
  • Pass IGCSE / O-Level — min Grade C in any 5 subjects
  • Pass UEC — min Grade B in any 3 subjects
  • Any equivalent qualification recognised by the Government of Malaysia

Trial examination and forecast results are accepted for early application.

Assessment Breakdown

  • 50% Coursework — assignments, quizzes, projects & presentations
  • 50% Final Examinations (certain modules assessed 100% by coursework)
8

Scholarships & Financing

UNIMY is committed to making a future-focused education accessible from the very first year. A range of scholarships, bursaries, and financial aid options are available for Foundation students including merit-based scholarships, the DHM Bursary, PTPTN and other government loan schemes, and flexible instalment and payment plan options. Full details are available through the admissions team and UNIMY’s financial aid channels.
